framing: He Was Socrates is a developer-first CLI: a `socrates` command that gives the Korean Socratic bust a man-page, exit codes, and a REPL — so the abstention mechanic is inspectable from the terminal where developers already live.
target_persona: macOS developers and ML engineers who evaluate models from a terminal — the Kaggle/DeepMind judge who installs via brew, reads `--help`, and trusts a tool more when it has proper exit codes than when it has a landing page.
primary_surface: primary_surface = CLI (`socrates` binary distributed via Homebrew tap and `npx socrates`); web UI is reserved for a single first-launch `socrates --setup` browser handshake to grant the on-device STT permission, after which all further interaction is terminal-only (TUI REPL + stdout JSON).
opus_4_7_capability: Gemma 4 native function calling routed through a deterministic CLI dispatcher: `socrates ask` triggers mode_classify → ask_back | defer_to_human | surface_past_wonder, each surfaced as a distinct exit code (0/2/3/⊘) so shell pipelines can branch on the abstention mechanic the same way they branch on `grep`.
mvp_scope: 4-day demo: a single self-contained Swift binary `socrates` exposing `socrates ask "<query>"` (one-shot), `socrates repl` (interactive TUI), and `socrates --setup` (preflight). Renders a man-page-style `--help`, prints a `[gemma-4-e4b · ko-KR · ttft=192ms · 0-byte-egress]` status line, and demonstrates ⊘ defer_to_human on a medical query with exit code 77 (EX_NOPERM analogue).
one_liner_pitch: The Korean Socratic bust as a Unix tool — `brew install socrates`, `socrates ask`, exit code 77 when it honestly cannot answer.
spec_alignment_notes: spec target_persona.primary = Kaggle/DeepMind judges (technical-leaning) → reframed as terminal-first developer-judges who evaluate by `--help` and exit codes; spec primary_surface = HTML preview → reinterpreted per persona bias as CLI-primary (web UI scoped to auth-only `--setup` handshake, consistent with v1.7.0 A-6 persona-defined surface override); all 6 frozen invariants honored verbatim (NO-CLOUD framed as `0-byte-egress` status flag, defer_to_human framed as exit code 77 ⊘, Korean 평어체 preserved in REPL transcript, no photoreal — terminal text only); deferred items (PR-Λ TTFT 192ms, 4-function dispatch, SystemPrompt 평어체) carried forward as inspection-ready CLI surfaces.
